$source: Contractor's Release of Liens read in full from page 6 of "225020 - Pay App 4-R2 - MWA Certified.pdf"; its schedule for payment carries all six figures. Subcontractor waivers taken from the audit trails on pages 14 and 18, which record them as submitted and approved but do not reproduce them.
$note: The release restates the application under oath — contract amount, completed to date, retainage, earned less retainage, previous payments and amount now payable — and all six agree to the cent, so W2 passes six times rather than once. The interesting behaviour is W5. Two subcontractors are billing, both have waivers recorded in the audit trail, and neither document was enclosed. That is neither a pass nor a failure: the engine reports it as unchecked and says exactly what it knows, which is that the waivers exist and nothing about them could be verified. Reporting them as missing would be a false alarm about paperwork that demonstrably exists; reporting them as satisfied would claim a check that never happened.
